title: Local residue-field criterion for universal injectivity
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a local ring and $u:M\to N$ an $R$-linear map. If $M$ is projective over $R$, $N$ is flat over $R$, and the induced map $M/\mathfrak mM\to N/\mathfrak mN$ is injective, then $u$ is universally injective: for every $R$-module $L$, the map $L\otimes_R M\to L\otimes_R N$ is injective [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] [def-weil-pbc-projective-module].
